candidates.title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
candidates.why_candidate: Transfers interaction knowledge from unprecedented-scale unlabeled human video into a controllable robot world model and distills it to sustained real-time generation.

candidates.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
candidates.why_candidate: Connects automated real-to-sim reconstruction with systematic digital-cousin generation and validates both policy ranking and zero-shot real transfer.

candidates.title: MolmoB0T: Large-Scale Simulation Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Demonstrates a fully open sim-only manipulation stack that transfers zero-shot to two real robot platforms without target-domain fine-tuning.

candidates.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Unifies unusually large scene, asset, grasp, simulator-portability, and factor-controlled evaluation layers in one open embodied ecosystem.

candidates.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
candidates.why_candidate: Shows that one embodied reasoning checkpoint can match specialist systems while retaining explicit episodic memory and tool-calling for robot planning.

candidates.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
candidates.why_candidate: Treats manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction as one transferable action-generation problem instead of separate specialist policies.

candidates.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
candidates.why_candidate: Uses the invertible correspondence of flow matching to translate coarse semantic actions into precise policy-native actions and a compact learnable noise-space controller.

candidates.title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
candidates.why_candidate: Turns forward-inverse asymmetry into a self-verification and exploration mechanism instead of estimating forward-model uncertainty directly.

candidates.title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
candidates.why_candidate: Provides the largest reported open synchronized medical-robot corpus and demonstrates both a VLA and one-checkpoint multi-platform world model on it.

candidates.title: Q-Learning With World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Narrow model-based RL contribution lacks an official embodied demo surface and does not clear the impact threshold for this registry.

candidates.title: Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written
candidates.why_candidate: Useful diagnostic result, but narrow action-encoding scope and impact prior 2 fall below the acceptance threshold.
